{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Cross-tabulate arm with other key variables to check for confounding

# Site
print("\nSite distribution by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['site']))

# Severity
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))

# Age
print("\nAge by arm (mean):")
print(df.groupby('arm')['age'].mean())

# Sex
print("\nSex distribution by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['sex']))"}
